trajectory_summary: This is a short, low-friction call: an inbound-inquiry customer who is already warm, a rep who moves through verify items in order, and a callback booked with day and time locked. The call's main gaps are omissions rather than active mishandling — the bill was captured but never flipped, the wife identified on title was never looped into the callback, and the Tesla black-panel comment was acknowledged but not used as a hook. Energy did not leak, but the rep left available value on the table rather than compounding it.
outcome_dispute: The call books a specialist callback for tomorrow 11AM (a locked day+time), which functions as 'tentative' rather than a fully booked closer appointment — the specialist call itself is the actual sales appointment, and this call only secures the pre-step (usage data + callback slot). Categorizing as 'callback' is more accurate than 'booked' since the substantive appointment has not yet occurred.
